selection_scope: Seven pilot questions that MemGen-always failed and that exposed at least one inference-time trigger candidate.
selection_basis: Question text plus the visible prefix at each candidate in N_memgen_no_inference only. Gold answers and N-condition scores were not consulted before this file was fixed.
intervention_rule: Invoke memory at exactly one selected inference candidate and skip every other inference candidate. Prompt augmentation remains enabled.

gsm8k_test_0710.rationale: All four item costs and the subtotal are complete; this is the clean phase boundary immediately before applying the loyalty discount.

gsm8k_test_0063.rationale: The first-half total and discounted monthly rate are available; invoke before integrating the six discounted months into the annual total.

gsm8k_test_0423.rationale: The prefix has just entered an incorrect savings allocation. This is the earliest available correction point, although it is not a clean semantic boundary.

gsm8k_test_1088.rationale: The weekday weekly total is complete; invoke at the transition to adding the separate Saturday and Sunday learning time.

gsm8k_test_0611.rationale: The first candidate appears just before the model commits to treating the five-month initial funding as a per-month amount, so it is the earliest viable correction point.

gsm8k_test_0976.rationale: Invoke before resolving the cross-day gingerbread and apple-pie quantities, where the visible reasoning is about to conflate Saturday and Sunday.

gsm8k_test_0754.rationale: Invoke at the start of the first sticker-to-button conversion, before the model can confuse stickers traded with buttons received.
